description: Creates or fully replaces a presentation's interactive questions in one call. Each call carries the COMPLETE presentation: title, optional settings, and the ordered list of all questions including correct answers for scored types (valid types and fields: `sparka_question_types_list`). Without `presentation_id` it creates a new presentation; with it, it replaces that presentation entirely — the ID stays the same, so a deck already using it keeps working, and unchanged question IDs keep matching the deck's slides. The questions without answers are readable by anyone who has the `presentation_id`; that is how decks and participants' phones load them. Returns `presentation_id`, the stored questions WITHOUT answers, and `embed_block`: a ready-to-paste `<script type="application/json" id="sparka-questions">` element for the deck. A working deck contains `embed_block` exactly once with no answers added, and never the user's Sparka secret key (`spk_live_…`) — the `presentation_id` is all a deck needs. The deck's JavaScript pattern is in `sparka_deck_guide`. After the questions change, a deck needs the new `embed_block`; an outdated one shows a mismatch banner. Validation problems come back as an error with JSON paths.
